name: Mobile Medical Couch
summary: Examination couch with a backrest that locks in eight positions.
description: A sturdy mobile examination couch for consulting rooms and wards. The backrest adjusts and locks in eight positions, and the frame is built for years of daily use.

name: Self Propelled Wheelchair
summary: Folding aluminium wheelchair with flip-up arms and swing-away footrests.
description: A lightweight folding aluminium wheelchair in metallic burgundy. Flip-up desk-length arms let the user get close to tables, and the footrests swing away and lift off for transfers.

name: Transit Wheelchair
summary: Attendant-pushed folding wheelchair with removable arms.
description: A folding transit chair for moving patients around a facility or between appointments. Removable armrests and swing-away footrests make transfers easier, and the inner liners are heavy duty.

name: Lightweight Safety Walker
summary: Folding walker with a padded seat, backrest and storage bag.
description: A folding safety walker that gives support on the move and a place to rest. Handles adjust in height, and it folds flat for storage or the car boot.

name: Minor Surgery Couch
summary: Manually adjustable couch with head-down tilt for minor procedures.
description: A couch for minor surgical procedures. The backrest and foot section adjust manually and lock themselves in place, and the couch tilts head-down when needed.

name: Mobile Commode Chair
summary: Wheeled commode and shower chair for safe patient transfer.
description: A mobile commode chair that doubles as a shower chair, for moving patients safely to and from the bathroom.

name: Coolview C35 Examination Light
summary: Examination light with a 20,000 lux spot and a 5,000 lux flood.
description: An examination light with two modes: an intense 20,000 lux spot for detailed work and a gentle 5,000 lux flood for general examination, from a 35 W source.

name: Zenith ULTRA-500LA Binocular Microscope
summary: Laboratory microscope, ×40 to ×1000 (×1600 with optional eyepieces).
description: A binocular laboratory microscope with paired ×10 DIN widefield eyepieces and parfocal DIN-standard objectives. Magnification runs from ×40 to ×1000, or ×1600 with optional ×16 flatfield eyepieces.

name: Autoclaves & Decontamination
summary: Sterilisation and decontamination supplies for clinical settings.
description: Sterilisation and decontamination supplies, including antimicrobial hospital concentrate for general antiseptic use. Ask our team for the full range.

name: 3M Littmann Electronic Stethoscope
summary: Amplifies body sounds up to 18 times.
description: An electronic stethoscope that amplifies sound up to 18 times, made for heart and body sounds that are hard to hear with an acoustic chest piece.
features: For difficult-to-hear heart and body sounds

name: Accoson Freestyle Sphygmomanometer
summary: Manometer with mercury isolation valve and latex-free bulb.
description: A blood pressure monitor with a plastic manometer tube and a mercury isolation valve, supplied with an adult velcro cuff, a latex-free bulb and coiled tubing.

name: Microlab MK6 Spirometer
summary: Portable spirometer with rechargeable batteries.
description: A portable, lightweight spirometer in a high-impact ABS body, powered by rechargeable internal batteries for use away from the desk.

name: Elemental Mains Cautery Unit
summary: Mains cautery with variable output up to 20 A.
description: A mains-powered cautery unit with variable output up to 20 amperes, robust cables and handles, and non-slip feet.

name: Accu-Chek Advantage Meter
summary: Blood glucose kit with finger pricker, strips and lancets.
description: A complete blood glucose kit: the Accu-Chek Advantage meter with a Softclix finger pricker, 10 test strips, 10 lancets, and high and low control solutions.

name: Kamplex KT 20 Impedance Audiometer
summary: Hand-held tympanometer for middle-ear testing in children.
description: A hand-held tympanometer for testing middle-ear function, designed for use with young children.

name: A-UB401 Digital Wrist Monitor
summary: Compact wrist BP monitor showing systolic, diastolic and pulse at once.
description: An ultra-compact wrist blood pressure monitor. Its three-line display shows systolic, diastolic and pulse readings together.

name: Polaroid HealthCam Kit
summary: Instant photographic records with a measuring grid overlay.
description: Instant clinical photographs with a grid overlay for recording wounds and conditions. The kit includes the camera, twin-pack grid film, a shoulder bag, a light lock and a non-contact close-up lens.
features: Shoulder bag and light lock included

name: Polaroid Macro 5 SLR
summary: Instant close-up camera for clinical documentation.
description: An instant camera for close-up clinical documentation. Contact our team for the current specification.

name: Universal Cervical Collar
summary: Comfortable, easy-to-fit collar for a range of cervical injuries.
description: An economical cervical collar that is comfortable to wear and quick to apply, for a variety of cervical injuries.

name: Drive Medical Heavy Duty Suction Machine
summary: Oil-less suction unit built for continuous operation.
description: A heavy-duty suction machine built for continuous use. It has an anti-bacterial filter, a vacuum regulator, an anti-vibration gauge, and a collection bottle with overflow protection.

name: Closed Infant Incubator
summary: Stationary incubator for standard and intermediate infant care.
description: A stationary closed incubator for standard and intermediate infant care, with simple controls and easy access to the patient.

name: Microcomputer Anesthesia Machine
summary: Anaesthesia delivery with integrated monitoring and records.
description: An anaesthesia workstation that brings monitoring, anaesthesia delivery and care-process records into one system, with the option to connect to a hospital server.

name: Infrared Circulation Foot Massager
summary: High-frequency foot massage with adjustable infrared heat.
description: A therapeutic foot massager that combines high-frequency massage with adjustable infrared heat and eight natural magnets to support blood circulation.

name: Massage Chair
summary: 3D massage mechanism with air massage and heated heads.
description: A full massage chair with a 3D mechanism, air massage, three massage and stretching techniques, and heated massage heads.
